picks.title: 1 Nephi 7: Nephi chooses to Forgive
picks.summary: Nephi and his brothers face another difficult journey—and this time, things get really hard between them. When Nephi is treated badly, he chooses to forgive and trust Heavenly Father. In this episode, kids will learn that even when someone hurts our feelings, we can choose to forgive, pray for help, and keep following Jesus Christ.
picks.reason: Latter-day Saint scripture story teaching forgiveness and trust in God.

picks.title: 1 Nephi 5: Sariah Learns to Trust Heavenly Father
picks.summary: In this episode, we’ll learn about Sariah and what happened when her sons were sent back to Jerusalem to get the brass plates. As she waited and worried about her boys, Sariah learned to trust the Heavenly Father and have faith that He would help her family.
picks.reason: Story of Sariah learning faith and trust in Heavenly Father.

picks.title: Choose Christ | Alexander Dushku | September 2026
picks.summary: Why choose Christ? Because He is real! He is the most real thing in this world. He is “in all and through all things”—the “light and life” of the whole world, and of your individual world and mine. Alexander Dushku, a General Authority Seventy of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, delivered this devotional address on September 22, 2026. You can access the full talk here.See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
picks.reason: A Latter-day Saint devotional on choosing Christ as central to life and meaning.

picks.title: Sister Alynda Kusch: "Back" Home Safely
picks.summary: In this devotional, Sister Alynda Kusch compares the voice of the Holy Ghost to a coach calling “Back!” to help a runner return safely to the base. Through personal experiences involving missionary service, prayer, education, and moments of physical difficulty, Sister Kusch shares four ways the Holy Ghost can bless our lives: teaching us what to do, teaching us to pray, helping us remember what we have learned and who we are, and comforting us in difficult moments. picks.reason: Devotional on Holy Ghost guidance and comfort in LDS life.
